items.raw_excerpt: Booth-level officers streamline electoral notice distribution through group hearings, reducing crowding and maximizing efficiency in Hyderabad's localities.
items.summary_en: Booth-level officers in Hyderabad are conducting group hearings locality-wise to distribute electoral notices more efficiently. The approach reduces crowding at polling stations and speeds up the process for residents. Local officials handle the bulk of the work to keep things running smoothly.
items.summary_ko: 히드라바드의 동네 선거관리관들이 주민 구역별 단체 청문회를 열어 선거 통지 배부를 더 효율적으로 진행하고 있다. 이 방식은 투표소 혼잡을 줄이고 주민들의 처리 속도를 높인다. 현지 관리들이 대부분의 업무를 맡아 원활하게 운영을 유지하고 있다.
items.title_en: Hyderabad BLOs streamline notice distribution with group hearings
items.title_ko: 히드라바드 BLO, 구역별 단체 청문으로 선거 통지 배부 간소화
items.title_original: BLOs do the heavy lifting; group hearings to be conducted locality wise

items.raw_excerpt: A south Auckland community hub is being shut down by its landlord Kainga Ora, despite those involved in the hub saying it has helped make the neighbourhood a better place.
items.summary_en: A community hub in south Auckland is being closed by its landlord Kainga Ora. People involved say the hub has helped make the neighbourhood a better place.
items.summary_ko: 사우스 오클랜드의 커뮤니티 허브가 소유자 Kainga Ora에 의해 폐쇄되고 있다. 해당 허브 관계자들은 이곳이 동네를 더 살기 좋은 곳으로 만드는 데 기여했다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Kainga Ora shuts down South Auckland community hub to use space for housing

items.title_original: Kainga Ora shuts down South Auckland community hub to use space for housing

items.raw_excerpt: La destacada deportista del Team ParaChile recibió la noticia a través de una videollamada del ministro del Deporte.
items.summary_en: Katherinne Wollermann, a prominent Paralympic athlete from Team ParaChile, has been named the winner of the 2025 National Sports Award. She received the exciting news through a video call from the Minister of Sports. This recognition highlights her achievements in Paralympic sports.
items.summary_ko: 카테린 볼레르만은 패러칠레 소속 저명한 패럴림픽 선수로 2025년 국가 스포츠상 수상자로 선정되었습니다. 그녀는 스포츠 장관의 화상 통화로 이 희소식을 전해 들었습니다. 이번 수상은 패럴림픽 스포츠에서의 그녀의 업적을 인정하는 것입니다.
items.title_en: Chilean Paralympic Athlete Wins National Sports Award

items.title_original: Katherinne Wollermann fue elegida como la ganadora del Premio Nacional del Deporte 2025

items.raw_excerpt: What's the longest flight time between Australian capitals? And which US state is home to the birthplace of rock'n'roll, Memphis?
items.summary_en: ABC Australia shares a fun travel quiz this week. It asks which Australian capital city has the longest flight time from other capitals. It also asks which US state is home to Memphis, the birthplace of rock and roll.

items.title_original: Take a trip with us in this week's travel quiz

items.raw_excerpt: Raquel Lyra busca a reeleição ao governo de PE contra João Campos e outros seis políticos. Veja a lista
items.summary_en: Raquel Lyra is seeking re-election as governor of Pernambuco state. She faces competition from João Campos and six other politicians in the 2026 race.

items.raw_excerpt: Harikatha artistes seek government support to promote their art and engage youth in major temple programs.
items.summary_en: Harikatha performers in Andhra Pradesh are asking the government for funding and help to keep the traditional storytelling art alive. They want to use large temple programs to bring young people into the art form.

items.title_en: Harikatha artists seek government support to keep their art alive

items.raw_excerpt: Anchoring the pulse of Avenida da Liberdade, the historic Cinema São Jorge served as the vibrant home for the second edition of the Worten Mock Fest – Festival Internacional de Comédia, which ran its final acts through 30 August.
items.summary_en: The second Worten Mock Fest comedy festival finished its final shows at Cinema São Jorge on Avenida da Liberdade. The historic Lisbon venue hosted international comedians for the event running through 30 August.
items.summary_ko: 제2회 Worten Mock Fest 코미디 페스티벌이 Avenida da Liberdade의 Cinema São Jorge에서 마지막 공연을 선보이며 막을 내렸다. 이 행사는 8월 30일까지 국제 코미디언들이 참여한 가운데 리스본의 이 역사적인 영화관에서 진행되었다.
items.title_en: Lisbon Comedy Festival Wraps Up at Historic Cinema
items.title_ko: 리스본 Historic Cinema에서 코미디 페스티벌 마무리
items.title_original: The Worten Mock Fest in Lisbon

items.raw_excerpt: Parents have been warned to on the lookout for Rotavirus.
items.summary_en: South Africa's National Institute for Communicable Diseases has warned parents about a rise in Rotavirus cases in Pretoria. Rotavirus is a common virus that causes severe diarrhea in young children. Health officials are urging parents to watch for symptoms and seek medical care early.
items.summary_ko: 남아공 국립감염병연구소(NICD)가 프리토리아 지역의 로타바이러스 환자가 늘고 있다며 부모들의 주의를 당부했다. 로타바이러스는 영유아에게 심한 설사를 유발하는 흔한 바이러스다. 보건 당국은 증상을 잘 살펴보고 초기에 진료를 받을 것을 권고하고 있다.
items.title_en: South Africa health institute warns parents as Rotavirus cases rise in Pretoria
items.title_ko: 남아공 질병관리기관, 프리토리아 로타바이러스 환자 증가에 부모 주의 당부
items.title_original: NICD warns parents as Rotavirus cases rise in Pretoria

items.raw_excerpt: Temporal provocou rajadas de vento de até 81 km/h e ocorrências pontuais
items.summary_en: Heavy rain hit Curitiba, Brazil, bringing strong winds up to 81 km/h. The storm caused street flooding, soil erosion, and some homes lost their roof tiles. No serious injuries were reported.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 쿠리치바에 시속 81km의 강한 바람을 동반한 폭우가 쏟아졌다. 도시 곳곳에 도로 침수와 토사 유출, 지붕 기와 파손 피해가 발생했으나 인명 피해는 보고되지 않았다.
items.title_en: Heavy rain causes flooding and roof damage in Curitiba

items.title_original: Chuva causa alagamento, erosão e destelhamento em Curitiba - Band News FM Curitiba

items.summary_en: Altura, a small town in the Alto Palancia region, is participating in a prestigious olive oil competition known as the Grand Prix. The village is also home to the famous Santuario de la Cueva Santa, a historic religious site.
